programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: A motorcycle workshop owner feels compelled to damn the physical and legal consequences and go on racing.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: The dedicated wife of a man being pressured by a nasty belly dancer uncovers a pit of deceit, double-crosses, murder and blackmail.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: After a young mother and her husband die, one child is sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: This award-winning film starts when Yang Tsung-pao is killed while fighting invaders from West Hsia - and the Yang clan forms their own army in retaliation.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: In The Kung-fu Instructor, Ti Lung plays hero Huang Yang, a righteous weapon instructor whose main concern eventually becomes his survival.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Desperate to win a dare in which he has to acquire a sword from a legendary swordsmaker, a swordsman takes it by foul means and has to pay the price.

programme.title: Forever and Ever
programme.desc: Huangmei Opera queen, Ivy Ling Po stars in this tale of a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter a girl who is dying.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Real-life champion martial artist Chen Kuan-Tai plays a powerful role in this action-packed saga where he fights for his true love.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: When villains 'Winged Tiger' Teng Fei and 'Underworld King' Yin Te Lung unite, the martial arts world is plunged into chaos. Can this deadly duo be stopped?

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: 5 Shaolin rebels train hard in order to successfully defeat their Manchu enemies. Starring David Chiang, Ti Lung, Alexander Fu.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: Controversial director Chu Yuan combines stars to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women expect of it.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Loyal to the emperor, the protagonist attempts to stop the delivery of a message depicted across twelve gold medallions that is to be delivered by traitors.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy.

programme.title: All Men Are Brothers
programme.desc: This star-studded martial arts epic adaptation of one of China's most celebrated novels is the sequel to The Water Margin.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Regular Joes turn heroes to save their neighbourhood, when a local mobster decides to turn their local gossip spot into a gambling den!

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: In true Huangmei opera style, lovely Li Hsiang-chun stars as a used and abused beauty in director Kao Li's restrained, as well as sadistic tearjerker.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Fans of 'The Little Mermaid' are in for a delightful surprise when they see this spectacular Chinese operatic adaptation, where a carp turns into a fairy.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Actress Lily Ho plays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senseless maiming and her mother's rape. 18 years later, it's payback time.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: A pair of female martial artists end up banding together to go up against the evil Black Demon. Starring Cheng Pei Pei.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: When the Emperor employs Manchu boxers to eradicate the Shao Lin martial artists, see how two escapees begin a quest to restore the reputation of Shao Lin.

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: This is the first of four related Shaw Brothers film adaptations of the legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Pale Passion

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Various people are out to get the Shadow Whip (an individual, not just a weapon). Starring Cheng Pei Pei and Yueh Hua.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This drama takes on a group of young people who get entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: The Merry Wife

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: A traitorous clansman bids to locate and then unleash the deadly 'Five Venom Spider' against those who bid to stand in his way.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Boxer From the Temple
programme.desc: A monk nicknamed 'The Kid' finds a barrage of gang fights on his hands after he meets a cruel bandit's son and an abused prostitute.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: A cruel uncle stands in the way between a young scholar and the beautiful gal with whom he falls in love, and happiness.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Sek Kin takes a refreshing break from his usual villain's role, playing a friendly ghost who befriends a young boy and helps him reunite his separated parents.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Ti Lung returns as Li Chin Huan, the renowned swordsman who must face the Chief of the Money Clan and his legion of assassins for the fate of the 'Martial Arts World'.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A young woman, who has gone through life disguised as a boy, must deal with her family's pressure for her to marry and the love of another woman.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: In this chapter of the 'Journey to the West' saga, the Monkey King and his gang are confronted by a whole host of fanciful villains.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins

programme.title: Man of Iron
programme.desc: In this fight-filled sequel, Chen Kuan-tai's character wins a bet against a gang leader's son. Soon, father and son are hot on his heels!

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: Hsu Hsia, a great kung fu actor himself, both directs and leads a team of four martial arts choreographers in his hilarious tale of 'kung fu pickpockets.'

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: Two men find more than they bargained for when they attempt to investigate the apparent murder of a swordsman.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer

programme.title: The Human Goddess

RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: SALAM SANTAI
programme.desc: Assalamualaikum...Mulakan hari anda dengan SALAMfm-Salam Untuk Semua. Kami temani malam anda dengan segmen Salam Santai bermula pukul 12.00 tengah malam hingga 4 pagi dengan pelbagai pengisian program Islamik menarik dan hiburan yang mendidik jiwa.

programme.title: SALAM TILAWAH 2026
programme.desc: Program pembelajaran teknik bacaan ayat-ayat suci Al Quran dengan betul. Memfokuskan tentang pembelajaran bagaimana untuk memperelokkan bacaan, taranum, pembelajaran tajwid, ilmu qiraat dan pengajaran ayat.

programme.title: KELUARGA USTAZ AQIL 2026
programme.desc: Drama berunsur Islamik yang menampilkan Ustaz Aqil dibintangi Ustaz PU Rahmat sebagai watak utama dan dj-dj SALAMfm sebagai pelakon tambahan tentunya akan menarik halwa telinga anda. Nantikan istimewa hanya di SALAMfm.

programme.title: TAMADUN ISLAM 2026
programme.desc: Kami kongsikan kepada anda perincian mengenai kisah Sirah dan tokoh-tokoh Islam terkemuka serta tidak ketinggalan kisah keagungan peradaban Islam.

programme.title: HARI INI DALAM SEJARAH (HIDS)
programme.desc: Setiap hari ada sejarah yang tercipta...ikuti apakah peristiwa yang berlaku setiap hari dalam HIDS

programme.title: KAK BEDAH TUDUNG BAWAL 2026
programme.desc: Celoteh Islamik berunsur nasihat yang ringkas namun padat ini mengandungi nasihat keagamaan disampaikan Kak Bedah yang sinonim dengan pemakaian tudung bawal sebagai identitinya yang tersendiri. Melalui pendekatan yang bersahaja tapi penuh makna ini, diharapkan mesej Islam dapat disampaikan dengan lebih mudah difahami dan diamalkan.

programme.title: TADARUS 2026
programme.desc: Hayati alunan bacaan ayat-ayat suci Al-Quran setiap hari mengikut turutan juzuk dan surah dalam Al-Quran.

programme.title: NIDA UL ISLAM 2026
programme.desc: Dengarkan kapsul Nida Ul Islam di mana penceramah akan memberikan tazkirah atau perkongsian pendek berkisarkan isu-isu semasa dan terkini selama 3-5 minit

programme.title: LUGHATUL SALAM 2026
programme.desc: Mengenal, mempelajari,menghayati dan bertutur dalam pelbagai bahasa dalam kapsul Lughatul Salam terbitan Yunie Yunos

programme.title: GLOSARI ISLAM 2026

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Mawar and Florence decide to start a business, selling clothes online. Florence becomes the model of all Mawar’s designs. This business becomes successful and popular in such a short and demands are overwhelming. It takes a toll on Mawar’s studies. Florence convinces her that she needs to focus on school. Mawar argues that she doesn’t need to study because her business is doing so well. Florence quits the business. Mawar can’t do the business alone and has a hard time designing because Florence is her muse and it’s more fun with Florence. They decide to close the business and focus on school.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: PE class. The PE teacher injures himself while warming up the class. Zack has to take over. The boys want to play football, and the girls want to play volleyball. Zack tries to get them to do other activities such as high jump, 100-meter dash, etc. Danial challenges Zack on a high jump, shot put, and 100-meter dash. If Danial wins 2 out of 3, they get to play football next week. Zack agrees to do the challenge. Danial wins the high jump. Zack wins the shot-put challenge. Lastly, the 100-meter dash. Zack wins by a close distance. But he promises the students that they get to play football and volleyball anyway because as long as they exercise, it’s okay. But the girls play football, and the boys have to play volleyball.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Drama class. Cikgu Lakshmi teaches the students acting and the art of theatre. They put on a very bad show. The acting’s horrendous, the pronunciation of words is wrong, and they lack confidence. But Cikgu Lakshmi is patient. James Blond, who checks out the class out of curiousity, watches their show and stands in for one of the students, just to test out his acting skills. He puts on a show and overacts in his scenes, way too dramatic, a stark contrast of the students. His performance is distracting. Cikgu Lakshmi decides to make it a student-only affair. James Blond is disappointed because he can’t express himself onstage anymore. One day, when school ends, he goes up on the empty stage and begins monologuing without realizing that Cikgu Lakshmi is watching him.

programme.title: No Gadget No Problem
programme.desc: Dunia di mana keseronokan dan kreativiti tidak terikat pada skrin. Mengajak kanak-kanak untuk meneroka, bermain, dan menemui kegembiraan dalam aktiviti tanpa penggunaan peranti elektronik.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: The weekend ends, and Puan Sheila and Encik Jalaluddin goes back to normal mode. They start to sense something suspicious about Sky and Ramunah’s behaviour. They discover that they have been controlled by their children and they try to confront them. Out of panic, the children switch them to game mode. The game then goes haywire and the parents are stuck permanently in game mode. Sky and Ramunah call their friends over to help them undo what they have done.

programme.title: Rimau Bangku
programme.desc: Walaupun tidak memiliki fizikal dan stamina sebagi pemain bola tetapi Azman masih menyimpan cita-cita untuk menjadi pemain bola sepak yang berjaya.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students pull a prank on Wan Yunus, the gullible new student from Kelantan. They tell him that his crush, Florence, likes him but she is too shy to tell him. They lie to him about what Florence likes and gets him to dress silly, do silly things, and say silly things to her. He ends up embarrassing himself. The pranksters call it quits and apologize to them when they realize they’ve taken it too far. Wan Yunus forgives them. In the end, Florence tells him that she thinks Wan Yunus is cool and they can be friends. It makes Wan Yunus happy.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond decides to learn more about the locals. The students are happy to help. programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Sports Day. Zack, being the representative teacher for Rumah Sultan, trains the students for the main and most popular event which is the tug-of-war. He takes it way too seriously and his training is gruelling. On Sports Day, the team coached by James Blond (Rumah Lannister) wins and Zack’s team defeated. Zack demands a match between the coaches and challenges James Blond for a one-on-one tug-of-war. Puan Aida stops the match and makes the two teachers realize of how foolish and childish their rivalry is. Sports Day is about the students and for the students. They apologize to each other. But when Puan Aida goes away, the students ask them to continue the match as they cheer on.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Ronaldo has the flu but still attends school. He tries his best to hide it but James Blond finds out and tells him that he needs to go to the doctor and rest at home. But Ronaldo insists that he’s okay and the lessons should go on. But he keeps interfering the lesson by sneezing, coughing, and making everyone uncomfortable. In the end, James Blond takes Ronaldo to the teachers’ office and asks Encik Yusof to take care of the class. Ronaldo finally admits he’s sick and takes advantage of James Blond’s hospitality by being a demanding patient. A few days later, the whole class is down with flu. Ronaldo is the only one who’s well.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The English teacher’s method is too strict and ineffective. She has poor grasp of the language and very unqualified. She teaches the class the wrong pronunciations. Cikgu Joji the BM teacher replaces her and becomes the English and BM teacher. She can’t handle the workload and stress, and she mixes up the two subjects in one class. Encik Yusof, the Assistant Principal, brings in a new English teacher to the class…

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. He turns to Cikgu Joji for advice. Cikgu Joji teaches him to be firm and tough on them (and also explore the differences of British and Malaysian schools). James Blond becomes too tough, punishing the kids for small mischiefs and mistakes. In the end, Cikgu Joji makes him realize of his errors. He apologizes to the students. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: During recess, See Mi Nau’s brother, See Yew Soon, visits her and brings her food. He pesters her about school and studies, in school. James Blond notices this and asks her about it. She tells him about her brother and that he’s always montoring her activities and becomes too controlling. James Blond tells her that she needs to talk to him. See Mi Nau tells him that she finds it difficult to articulate her feelings. He teaches her about metaphors and analogies, how they help conveying messages clearer. She follows his advice talks to See Yew Soon and finally gets through to him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: For one assignment, the students partner up, interview and write an essay about each other. Danial is partnered up, by random draw from a hat, with Amelia. They sit down and interview each other. Danial enjoys talking about himself while Amelia is a hard person to go through. When the essays are done, Amelia — being the best in the class in English — insists on checking Danial’s essay, because each pair shares a mark. Danial is reluctant at first because he’s insecure about his writing but finally gives up. She reads his essay and discovers that he’s written a flattering essay about her. She finally opens, telling him more about herself.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond asks the students to talk about their heroes. But they misunderstood and talk about their favourite superheroes instead. James Blond corrects them and tells them about the real meaning of a ‘hero’ and not fictitious heroes, for example his uncle Edward who’s an SAS army and a mountaineer. Sam, the quiet one in the class, is too shy to even speak a complete sentence. However, he seems to be confident when correcting people about these superheroes’ facts. He’s a real pedantic geek. James Blond decides to talk about a superhero in class, getting all the facts wrong, to get Sam to speak confidently. And Sam, can’t bear hearing all the wrong facts, finally gains confidence and speak up.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Mawar and Florence decide to start a business, selling clothes online. Florence becomes the model of all Mawar’s designs. This business becomes successful and popular in such a short and demands are overwhelming. It takes a toll on Mawar’s studies. Florence convinces her that she needs to focus on school. Mawar argues that she doesn’t need to study because her business is doing so well. Florence quits the business. Mawar can’t do the business alone and has a hard time designing because Florence is her muse and it’s more fun with Florence. They decide to close the business and focus on school.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: PE class. The PE teacher injures himself while warming up the class. Zack has to take over. The boys want to play football, and the girls want to play volleyball. Zack tries to get them to do other activities such as high jump, 100-meter dash, etc. Danial challenges Zack on a high jump, shot put, and 100-meter dash. If Danial wins 2 out of 3, they get to play football next week. Zack agrees to do the challenge. Danial wins the high jump. Zack wins the shot-put challenge. Lastly, the 100-meter dash. Zack wins by a close distance. But he promises the students that they get to play football and volleyball anyway because as long as they exercise, it’s okay. But the girls play football, and the boys have to play volleyball.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Drama class. Cikgu Lakshmi teaches the students acting and the art of theatre. They put on a very bad show. The acting’s horrendous, the pronunciation of words is wrong, and they lack confidence. But Cikgu Lakshmi is patient. James Blond, who checks out the class out of curiousity, watches their show and stands in for one of the students, just to test out his acting skills. He puts on a show and overacts in his scenes, way too dramatic, a stark contrast of the students. His performance is distracting. Cikgu Lakshmi decides to make it a student-only affair. James Blond is disappointed because he can’t express himself onstage anymore. One day, when school ends, he goes up on the empty stage and begins monologuing without realizing that Cikgu Lakshmi is watching him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students pull a prank on Wan Yunus, the gullible new student from Kelantan. They tell him that his crush, Florence, likes him but she is too shy to tell him. They lie to him about what Florence likes and gets him to dress silly, do silly things, and say silly things to her. He ends up embarrassing himself. The pranksters call it quits and apologize to them when they realize they’ve taken it too far. Wan Yunus forgives them. In the end, Florence tells him that she thinks Wan Yunus is cool and they can be friends. It makes Wan Yunus happy.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond decides to learn more about the locals. The students are happy to help. They teach him all the basics like ordering food at a mamak restaurant, the salutations such as "macha", "brader" (not ‘brother’), "boss", etc. Wan Yunus teaches him how to flirt in Kelantanese dialect. In the end, he uses his knowledge to impress Cikgu Joji and takes her out on a date.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Malaysia Day. Class decoration competition lead by Gowri. They excel in the competition, winning first place. However, before they can receive the grand prize the judge, principal Puan Aida, asks them what exactly is Malaysia Day. None of the students can answer (even James Blond). The whole class is punished. Cikgu Joji educates them on Malaysia Day while all of them stand on their chairs.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Sports Day. Zack, being the representative teacher for Rumah Sultan, trains the students for the main and most popular event which is the tug-of-war. He takes it way too seriously and his training is gruelling. On Sports Day, the team coached by James Blond (Rumah Lannister) wins and Zack’s team defeated. Zack demands a match between the coaches and challenges James Blond for a one-on-one tug-of-war. Puan Aida stops the match and makes the two teachers realize of how foolish and childish their rivalry is. Sports Day is about the students and for the students. They apologize to each other. But when Puan Aida goes away, the students ask them to continue the match as they cheer on.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Ronaldo has the flu but still attends school. He tries his best to hide it but James Blond finds out and tells him that he needs to go to the doctor and rest at home. But Ronaldo insists that he’s okay and the lessons should go on. But he keeps interfering the lesson by sneezing, coughing, and making everyone uncomfortable. In the end, James Blond takes Ronaldo to the teachers’ office and asks Encik Yusof to take care of the class. Ronaldo finally admits he’s sick and takes advantage of James Blond’s hospitality by being a demanding patient. A few days later, the whole class is down with flu. Ronaldo is the only one who’s well.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: During recess, See Mi Nau’s brother, See Yew Soon, visits her and brings her food. He pesters her about school and studies, in school. James Blond notices this and asks her about it. She tells him about her brother and that he’s always montoring her activities and becomes too controlling. James Blond tells her that she needs to talk to him. See Mi Nau tells him that she finds it difficult to articulate her feelings. He teaches her about metaphors and analogies, how they help conveying messages clearer. She follows his advice talks to See Yew Soon and finally gets through to him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: For one assignment, the students partner up, interview and write an essay about each other. Danial is partnered up, by random draw from a hat, with Amelia. They sit down and interview each other. Danial enjoys talking about himself while Amelia is a hard person to go through. When the essays are done, Amelia — being the best in the class in English — insists on checking Danial’s essay, because each pair shares a mark. Danial is reluctant at first because he’s insecure about his writing but finally gives up. She reads his essay and discovers that he’s written a flattering essay about her. She finally opens, telling him more about herself.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond asks the students to talk about their heroes. But they misunderstood and talk about their favourite superheroes instead. James Blond corrects them and tells them about the real meaning of a ‘hero’ and not fictitious heroes, for example his uncle Edward who’s an SAS army and a mountaineer. Sam, the quiet one in the class, is too shy to even speak a complete sentence. However, he seems to be confident when correcting people about these superheroes’ facts. He’s a real pedantic geek. James Blond decides to talk about a superhero in class, getting all the facts wrong, to get Sam to speak confidently. And Sam, can’t bear hearing all the wrong facts, finally gains confidence and speak up.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Mawar and Florence decide to start a business, selling clothes online. Florence becomes the model of all Mawar’s designs. This business becomes successful and popular in such a short and demands are overwhelming. It takes a toll on Mawar’s studies. Florence convinces her that she needs to focus on school. Mawar argues that she doesn’t need to study because her business is doing so well. Florence quits the business. Mawar can’t do the business alone and has a hard time designing because Florence is her muse and it’s more fun with Florence. They decide to close the business and focus on school.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: PE class. The PE teacher injures himself while warming up the class. Zack has to take over. The boys want to play football, and the girls want to play volleyball. Zack wins by a close distance. But he promises the students that they get to play football and volleyball anyway because as long as they exercise, it’s okay. But the girls play football, and the boys have to play volleyball.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: A family of strict parents and siblings who don’t get along with each other. After an argument at the dinner table, Sky and Ramunah coop up in their rooms to rant about their parents with their friends. Right there and then, they discover a video game that can take their problems away.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah discover that they can really control their parents. They call their best friends over to plan an unforgettable weekend together. They finally get to do the things that their parents never allowed. Now, they can go all out and have the best time of their life.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: The weekend ends, and Puan Sheila and Encik Jalaluddin goes back to normal mode. They start to sense something suspicious about Sky and Ramunah’s behaviour. They discover that they have been controlled by their children and they try to confront them. Out of panic, the children switch them to game mode. The game then goes haywire and the parents are stuck permanently in game mode. Sky and Ramunah call their friends over to help them undo what they have done.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah received a message from a mysterious person whose name is beta about how they can save their parents. Before taking on the mission, the kids trains for it and they reflect on how they have been treating their parents, as well as questioning if their newfound freedom is more important than saving their parents.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky, Ramunah and their friends takes on the mission to save their parents after training hard for it.. Everything goes almost swimmingly, if not because of the three stooges, and along the way, Sky and Ramunah discover that their parents have been caring about them all along, but unfortunately, the kids failed the last task and they lost their parents to the limbo.

programme.title: Argentinian Comfort Food
programme.desc: Nothing's more warm and soothing than Argentinian comfort food and host Natalia Machado shows us how to make some!

programme.title: Italian Classics with Texture
programme.desc: Fun host Vanessa Gianfrancesco prepares an Italian feast with classic flavours and amazing textures.

programme.title: Chocolate Episode with Chef Katie Ardington
programme.desc: Masterful chef-host Katie Ardington loves chocolate, don't we all? Watch as she shares her chocolate handling knowledge and skill in this episode.

programme.title: Beef Episode with Chef Natalia Machado
programme.desc: Beef cookery is precious to Argentinian chef-host Natalia Machado; a world-class chef who combines modern technique with her deep cultural tradition.

programme.title: Gelatin Episode with Chef Craig Wong
programme.desc: Chef Craig Wong demystifies gelatin, an essential chef's staple ingredient, in this unique and fascinating episode!

programme.title: Stonefruit Episode with Chef Derek Dammann
programme.desc: Chef Derek Dammann loves and loves cooking with all sorts of fruit, but especially stone fruit; including peaches, mangoes, plums, cherries and"... almonds?

programme.title: Bar Food Done Good
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik go head-to-head to see who can come up with the most tantalizing bar bites! Josh makes fried halloumi, whitefish tartar, and a salad based on a drink, while Erica prepares beef tartare, escargot, and sliders!

programme.title: Fire and Ice
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik go head-to-head to see who can come up with the most tantalizing meal inspired by fire and ice! Josh makes arctic char crudo, duck breast, and a smores dessert, while Erica prepares sea bass crudo and fish curry!

programme.title: Cake
programme.desc: Unlock Gusto TV's top recipes on QR Countdown! Thousands of viewers scan our QR codes to access our delicious dishes. Now, we're serving up 8 of our most popular cake recipes, from hosts like Siobhan Detkavich and Michael Bonacini.

programme.desc: Unlock Gusto TV's top recipes on QR Countdown! Thousands of viewers scan our QR codes to access our delicious dishes. Now, we're serving up 8 of our most popular cornbread recipes, from hosts like Natalia Machado and Spencer Watts.

programme.title: Ziggy Marley

programme.title: Al Roker Part 1
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Al Roker and his daughter Courtney Roker Laga’s cookbook Al Roker’s Recipes to Live By! Follow along as Shahir prepares chicken shawarma bowls, Maryland-style crab cakes, and a spectacular chili!

programme.title: Brie Larson Part 1

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.nnCustomers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service.nnThe owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others.nnWorking with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: Trentino-Alto Adige
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. programme.title: Trentino-Alto Adige
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Friuli Venezia Guilia
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Sicily

programme.title: Piemonte
programme.desc: Piemonte cuisine is influenced by its mountainous terrain. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us how to make its warm regional dishes like Bagna Cauda.

programme.title: Popular Athens Recipes
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: Greek Night
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a delicious Greek feast in around 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: Olives: The Most Useful Ingredient
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: Canada + Greece
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: Hearty Greek Fare
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it!

programme.title: Leaves and Lettuces
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more!

programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: What You Wish For
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck chef with gambling problems flees to a Latin American villa to join a team of chefs who cook for the super rich. He soon gets more than he bargained for when he discovers the dark secrets of his employer's unique and dangerous culinary appetite

programme.title: Happily Never After: Wedding Bell Blues
programme.desc: Together, music teacher Wilma and Richard create a perfect harmony. But the music stops when their newlywed home is transformed into the setting for a tragedy.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers- The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death’s door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore’s symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore’s vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore’s two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E037
programme.desc: Eugenia se disculpa con Yosmir por la forma en que lo trató frente a sus amigas y le explica sus motivos; el jovencito considera que si para ella es tan complicado estar con él debería pensarlo mejor. Hilario no quiere darle información a Florencia sobre el "negro Quijada", pero la muchacha le asegura que su intención es sólo pedirle disculpas al familia del hombre como Rosendo le encomendó. Hilario está tratando de convencer a Adelaida de que está feliz por su regreso a Cantarrana cuando recibe una llamada de Florencia pidiéndole que vuelvan a verse. Clementina coquetea con Jonás para molestar a Antonieta y Felipe le reclama; el joven Osuna se desconcierta cuando la muchacha sugiere que está celoso. Jack se complace cuando Victoria le pide que le tenga paciencia y espere por ella.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E038
programme.desc: Nicolás quiere que Sigfrido lo ayude a ponerle una flor en la habitación todos los días a Victoria; el joven Del Casal acusa sorpresa cuando el niño le comenta que acaba de ver a Jack dándole un beso a Victoria. Victoria le comenta a Hilario sobre los papeles y las fotos que Nicolás encontró en Los Samanes y que ella destruyó al quemar la casa; la muchacha asegura a su padre ya se convenció de que nunca más puede creer en Nicolás. Hansen indaga con Felipe quién es Jack Builder, pues le llama la atención que el hombre estuvo haciéndole varias preguntas sobre Hilario a alguien con quien Guanipa está por cerrar un negocio. Adelaida se llena de indignación cuando Genara le cuenta que Hilario se fue en la avioneta y no está en la hacienda como le aseguró. Antonieta no quiere que Felipe se case con Clementina, pero se niega a aceptar que es porque el muchacho le importa.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E14
programme.desc: Tras pasar un agradable rato juntos, Joel se despide de Beatrice justo en el instante que Ignacio los interrumpe y, reconoce al mesero que lo vio besándose con Francesca.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E15
programme.desc: Joel toma su desayuno justo en el momento que Beatrice lo sorprende en la fonda Palacios

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E038
programme.desc: Nicolás quiere que Sigfrido lo ayude a ponerle una flor en la habitación todos los días a Victoria; el joven Del Casal acusa sorpresa cuando el niño le comenta que acaba de ver a Jack dándole un beso a Victoria. Victoria le comenta a Hilario sobre los papeles y las fotos que Nicolás encontró en Los Samanes y que ella destruyó al quemar la casa; la muchacha asegura a su padre ya se convenció de que nunca más puede creer en Nicolás. Hansen indaga con Felipe quién es Jack Builder, pues le llama la atención que el hombre estuvo haciéndole varias preguntas sobre Hilario a alguien con quien Guanipa está por cerrar un negocio. Adelaida se llena de indignación cuando Genara le cuenta que Hilario se fue en la avioneta y no está en la hacienda como le aseguró. Antonieta no quiere que Felipe se case con Clementina, pero se niega a aceptar que es porque el muchacho le importa.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E039

programme.desc: Builder se dispone a besar a la muchacha mientras Nicolás los observa desde lejos; la muchacha rechaza besar a Jack; en ese momento Del Casal se les acerca con intenciones de poner en su sitio a su rival. Hilario encarga a Moncho averiguar el paradero del "negro Quijada" y qué tanto sabe Florencia respecto al hombre. Victoria sufre una fuerte impresión al descubrir a Florencia besándose con Nicolás en plena calle; se les acerca para manifestarle su desprecio por haberla engañado y le asegura a Nicolás que para ella él está muerto y enterrado. Florencia está nerviosa porque teme que Victoria le cuente a Hilario que los vio besándose, pues eso significa que el hombre va a descubrir su engaño. Hansen se entera por Clementina de que Florencia está en la ciudad y concluye que fue por ella que Hilario dejó esperando a Adelaida.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E040
programme.desc: Builder se dispone a besar a la muchacha mientras Nicolás los observa desde lejos; la muchacha rechaza besar a Jack; en ese momento Del Casal se les acerca con intenciones de poner en su sitio a su rival. Hilario encarga a Moncho averiguar el paradero del "negro Quijada" y qué tanto sabe Florencia respecto al hombre. Victoria sufre una fuerte impresión al descubrir a Florencia besándose con Nicolás en plena calle; se les acerca para manifestarle su desprecio por haberla engañado y le asegura a Nicolás que para ella él está muerto y enterrado. programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E05 - Neighbours, Old and New
programme.desc: Casey and the crew go out in search of the family of the lost cub from the previous night. They hope that if they find them, the cub will have found them as well.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E06 - No Place Like Home
programme.desc: As the end of their expedition draws near, salmon and bear activity begins to decline, but that doesn’t mean that there aren’t some bears still lingering around the area. Casey and his crew wander the tidal flats and interior of Katmai and find the bones of a humpback whale that washed ashore.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers Of Nepal - S01:E01 - Lay Of The Land
programme.desc: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers, but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps. Casey and his camera crew arrive in Nepal and meet up with local tiger guide, Rajan Chadhary. A seasoned tracker, Rajan guides the team around the Bardiya National Park's tiger habitat and establishes a lay of the land.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers Of Nepal - S01:E02 - On The Tiger Trail
programme.desc: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers, but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps. While walking in the jungle, Casey and the team find their first tiger. While the tracks lead to a lot of dead ends, they discover a plethora of other wildlife along the way.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers Of Nepal - S01:E03 - Into The Tiger's Bedroom
programme.desc: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers, but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps.Casey and Rajan discuss different tactics for finding tigers: sit and wait for them to come to the water, or track them on foot through the jungle? After walking a riverbed, the team gets an intimate look at these rare cats.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E02 - Hammerhead Shark
programme.desc: Travel to the Bahamas as Andy Casagrande attempts to place a fin camera on the elusive hammerhead shark… what could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E03 - Tiger Shark
programme.desc: Ever wondered how a tiger shark hunts and feeds on its prey? Wildlife filmmaker Andy Casagrande travels off the coast of North Carolina to document never before seen behavior of one of the most misunderstood sharks in the world.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E51 - Return of the Wolves
programme.desc: Capture teams from the U.S. National Park Service track down and relocate wolves to Isle Royale National Park in Lake Superior under an ambitious initiative to restore balance to a wilderness ecosystem.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E59 - Saving the Right Whale
programme.desc: The North Atlantic Right Whale is on the verge of extinction. The leading cause of death and injury to the whales is from ship strikes or entanglement in fishing lines. In this Breakthrough episode, we will hear from the leading experts and biologists who are racing to save this species.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E01 - Wardens Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Wardens: Case Files offers a glimpse into the remarkable stories of seasoned wildlife officers. It will transport viewers into the heart of the action, immersing them in the thrill of the chase and the satisfaction of justice served.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E02 - Moose is Loose and Lost Coast
programme.desc: A surprise guest shows up at the elementary school, giving everyone quite a scare. Meanwhile, a sneaky Angler is on the prowl, putting a twist on "catch and release." It's up to the Game Wardens to stop him.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall
programme.desc: A rock-climbing disaster hurtles climber Craig DeMartino 100 feet down a granite cliff. A shattered heap of broken bones, Craig clings to life. In a split second, Craig's life becomes an inspiring fight to survive.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E02 - A River's Grasp
programme.desc: In an isolated mountain river, Fisherman Dean Ririe becomes hopelessly trapped under a boulder in water up to his neck. In icy waters that should kill a man, Dean fights for his life miles from help.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E01 - Introduction to Military Special Forces
programme.desc: "Special Operations" are special divisions of military, police or intelligence services that are highly qualified in specific areas of urban warfare and in a variety of special weapons and technology.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E02 - Introduction to Police Special Operations
programme.desc: As warfare has evolved, many military techniques and technologies have been adapted for use in urban settings by police units around the world. This episode provides viewers with an intimate perspective on what it feels like to be "inside the heads" of special police personnel, and how their use of military-style strategies and equipment allows them to save lives. From riot control in South Africa and the lessons learned from its excesses, to Los Angeles Police Chief Robert Gates’ creation of an elite police S.W.A.T team, CQB will showcase how, over the past 30 years, the fight against urban crime has evolved into a military scenario, with both sides using increasingly complex weaponry and tactics.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. This hour-long special, featuring a chat with author Andrew Morton, explores the social backdrop that makes their bold marriage fit right in with today's British Royal Family.

programme.desc: For the first time in history, NASA’s Parker Solar Probe has pierced the Sun’s corona and is orbiting above its surface. Scientists have a front-row seat to better understand the sun and predict huge solar eruptions that can cause serious damage when they hit Earth.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E01 - From There to Here
programme.desc: With the recent launch of the first privately owned space craft to service the international space station; it’s time to take a fresh look at The New frontiers of space. The sky above is littered with stars and countless galaxies. The next stage of our journey is with robotics, advanced technologies and sheer daring we are now going where before we only dreamt.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E02 - Return To The Moon
programme.desc: The Moon, our closest celestial companion. Our indispensible dance partner through the cosmos. Lighting our night sky and gently tugging at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, though her allure remains strong, once again we are glancing her way with reThe Newed interest and with a view to return very soon.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E03 - The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between us and our Star, the inner worlds; hidden within the sun's glare often only visible at sunrise or sunset. Venus the first and brightest star in the evening sky, and Mercury fleeting across the solar disk. They are half of our solar system's terrestrial planets and yet as we look at our companions they are posing more questions than answers.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E04 - Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: It has fired our imaginations for millennia, Mars, the God of War and the source of Man's science fictional demise. We know the dry barren planet was once flowing with vast reservoirs of water, the sky thick and filled with clouds and the tantalizing possibility of life. It is the only other place in our solar system than Man might

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E05 - The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. They vary in size from grains of dust to mountain sides, footballs to planetoids. They were the building Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E82 - Forecasting The Big One
programme.desc: Earthquakes can leave a path of destruction with no warning. Through the latest technology, scientists are scrambling for a breakthrough that can forecast where and when earthquakes will strike next.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E90 - Brain-Computer Interface: The Digital Mind
programme.desc: This is an inside look at how teams of scientists, engineers and surgeons—and their courageous test subjects—are using Brain-Computer Interfaces to bring hope and increased independence to patients living with conditions like paralysis, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and blindness.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: After the fall of the soviet union many countries remained in dispute in the early nineties despite eastern Europe‘s independence. In 1994 a bitter conflict broke out between the forces of the Chechen independence movement and the Russian regular army. Despite overwhelming manpower, weaponry and air support, the Russian forces were unable to establish effective permanent control over the mountainous area due to many successful Chechen guerrilla raids. Improvised Explosive Devices were one of the most effective methods employed in these disastrous raids and were the back drop to many Close Quarter Battle scenarios exchanged between the two sides.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E04 - SAS in Northern Ireland
programme.desc: The history of the British Empire colonial legacy in Northern Ireland is well known the world over but a there is a largely untold story of the the firefights between and close quarter battles exchanged between the provisional IRA, the British army and the elite SAS. Although the IRA often employed „terrorist" techniques within the city of London and on England‘s mainland not much is said of the often guerilla warfare techniques of the British Special Air Service in Northern Ireland since the beginning of this conflict. In this episode we will examine how the history of the Special Air Service affected the training of every elite force after it and how the close quarter battles in Northern Ireland in the late 1970s through to the millennium shaped both special forces and resistance methods.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E06 - Lobster Poaching and Black Walnut
programme.desc: In "Lobster Poaching," a poacher has a bad day by jumping into the wrong boat. Meanwhile, "Black Walnut" tells a story about a surprising species that catches a Game Warden's attention. Game Wardens reminisce about unforgettable cases and experiences from their jobs.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E05 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 1
programme.desc: Hunters Adrian Knopps and Garrett Hagen venture into the remotest part of Alaska's Misty Fjord, hunting Moose and Bear. After a successful hunt Adrian finds himself trapped by a twenty foot tidal surge after Garrett fails to return with the skiff.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E06 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 2
programme.desc: After a successful hunt., Adrian Knopps' hunting partner disappears taking their bear out to the boat. Now Adrian finds himself stranded on a tidal flat surround by bears and wolf packs and with massive storm bearing down on him. How will he survive?

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E05 - Delta Prison Rescue Operation
programme.desc: In 1989, CIA operative Kurt Muse was imprisoned at the notorious Carcel Modelo in Panama for his role in organizing radio transmissions against dictator Manuel Noriega. That December, an elite group of the US Delta Force breached the roof of the prison, and one of the most daring close quarter battle operations in history began. From the dramatic helicopter crash and wounding of several Delta operators to the extraction of the entire team by the 5th Infantry Division, this is prime material for CQB analysis. In this episode, CQB recreates the raid, focusing on the "sub-second" reflexes of the Delta Force team from the moment they entered the prison to their extraction from the roof of the prison by an MH-6 "Little Bird" helicopter.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E06 - Snipers and Scout
programme.desc: Joint Task Force Two (JTF 2) is the elite Canadian Forces Special Operations unit responsible for a broad range of missions, including counter-terrorism and armed assistance to other government departments. Highly secretive, JTF 2 and its predecessor, the Canadian Airborne Regiment, have been deployed in hotspots around the world from Haiti to Bosnia. This episode focuses on the legendary JTF sniper teams and their use in Afghanistan alongside the British SAS and the US Delta Force at "the sharp end of the spear." A book written by an ex-JTF member explains how, in 2006, both the Pentagon and the British Foreign Office noted the instrumental role that JTF 2 played in the rescue of the British and Canadian Christian Peacemaker Team held hostage in Iraq. Unique in look, the FN P90 personal defense weapon, used by JTF 2 soldiers and special police around the world, will be highlighted in this program.
